name: attesting a work product
from: A work product whose passing is its worker's report: the conditions of done asserted by the party paid for them being met, indistinguishable from evidence to everything downstream.
to: The conditions of the work product's passing re-run by an office that did not make it and cannot repair it, each condition's settling a readout rather than a claim, and any condition that cannot be re-run reported as exactly that instead of assumed.
cost: Executing every check rather than reading any report — slower than trust on every occasion, and the whole reason the attestation is worth anything on the occasion it disagrees.
otherwise: A worker attesting its own work is the worker's opinion wearing evidence's shape; nothing downstream can tell a true attestation from a favourable one, and the first time schedule pressure meets an honest incumbent, favourable wins without anyone lying.
